avis.titre: Great Product!  Better Than Korean Skincare
avis.texte: Wow! Im now on my third container of the 20% glycolic acid pads. I'm someone that has had a lot facials, chemical peels and various acid products that are recommended to get rid of sebaceous hyperplasia. Several years later, nothing worked until I came across these pads. First of all the pad is superior to most pads that are sold in this type of product . It's very juicy and one side of the pad has a good texture to it (best Ive ever tried) other side is a little less textured than the other, I would definitely recommend that you test this product on your skin before proceeding because if you have very gentle skin, I wouldn't recommend starting off at 20%. It may be too much for you . I first started off with the Ordinary's Aha/BHA exfoliating liquid and I hated it. It was sticky and awful to wear and I didn't see any improvement after going through a bottle. I'm thinking that AHA/BHA has a own natural stickiness to it and that's why these products have that feel, however, it's not as sticky as the ordinary's product. And since I do this treatment at night, it's no big deal and after a little bit of time it dries off. Somehow I developed sebaceous hyperplasia (had 5 dots). One on my forehead, one on my left cheek and 3 on my right cheek . They look like tiny anthills that flattened out with a black dot on top. I have had so many professional treatments to get rid of it and not nothing has worked until this product. I also use sacalic acid pads because that type of acid is rec

I’ve been using the QRxLabs Glycolic Acid 20% Resurfacing Pads for a bit now, and overall they’re an okay product with some noticeable benefits, but also a few limitations. On the positive side, they do a good job of exfoliating the skin. After consistent use, my skin felt smoother and looked a bit more refreshed, especially in areas with rough texture. The pads are convenient and easy to use—just swipe after cleansing and you’re done, which makes them simple to fit into a routine. I also like that they give a noticeable “fresh skin” feel after application. It’s that slight tingling sensation that lets you know the product is active, but it wasn’t too harsh for me when used a few times a week. That said, the results are pretty gradual. While I did see some improvement in texture and brightness, it wasn’t anything dramatic or overnight. You definitely have to be consistent and patient to notice changes. Another thing is that it can be a bit strong if overused, so it’s not something I’d recommend using daily unless your skin is already used to acids. Moisturizing and sunscreen are definitely necessary with this kind of exfoliant. Overall, it’s a decent exfoliating product that does what it claims at a moderate level. It works well for smoothing and refreshing the skin, but it’s not a miracle solution for major skin concerns.

I am 57 and my wrinkles have been really showing more and more, I purchased these pads 3 times in last few years, I haven't used them in months and started struggling with my appearance of facial wrinkles and my skin was feeling rough, I remembered these pads so I purchased again I have been using them every night for 2 weeks and told myself I will not be without them again, I have noticed my skin is so very smooth and my wrinkles appear not so deep. I find since I use it every night I need a heavier face cream for morning before makeup, but I have had facial peels years ago and I have also done facial peels at home. My attempt with the pads is to achieve a peel for smoother skin its why I am using daily, I will probably do it daily for 30 days then go to once a week. I use them at night then sit in front of a fan to let dry, it feels a little sticky but drys pretty quick and you dont feel the sticky feeling for long, i dont put any moisturizer on with it only because i am trying to exfoliate the rough skin. I am highly satisfied with these pads they are working perfectly for what I am trying to achieve. I am considering purchasing the wash this company offers to see if using the wash with the pads I may get even better results, if I decide to purchase the wash, I will update my review.

They do leave a film, but since I use it before bed it isn’t a big deal. I just put on a heavy moisturizer and go to sleep. Basically like a mini chemical peel on a pad. Helps keep skin soft and exfoliated and pores clear. Recommend!

avis.titre: Love these Glycolic Acid Resurfacing Pads for smoother, softer and radiant skin
avis.texte: I love these Glycolic Acid Resurfacing Pads, they are effective, yet still feels gentle on your skin, no burning or stinging sensation, or maybe I just don't normally have very sensitive skin, but I can feel and see the effectiveness of these resurfacing pads and love them! avis.titre: Affordable Miracle when used with a balanced routine
avis.texte: I have NOTHING bad to say about this product. Not to be typical but I dont normally write reviews, however, as an acne sufferer of 10 years (24 YO) this has been an affordable miracle. For years, I bought products geared toward oily skin without much long term success and I recently adapted to a more anti-aging approach which is how I came across this. Yes, it could leave your skin dry; Yes, it could irritate, but this is the nature of the beast. When used with other products to replenish moisture and are gentle my skin handles this very well. My pores are smaller, breakouts are more shallow and heal faster and the hyperpigmentation fades quicker. This is now a staple. The first two pictures is when my skin was significantly worse than it is now, and the last three I just took to tonight. In addition to changing my skin care, I've also had to change my diet. I ignored this advice FOR A LONG TIME, dont make the mistake I did. I realized anything that upset my stomach, made my skin worse. I've cut diary out of my diet 90% and I've cut back on sugary juices and drinks, etc.

1) I did the skin 24 hour test because my skin can be a bit sensitive. Nothing. 2) I did not use it daily -- see above - sensitive 3) Beginning of Week 2, I started to notice that my skin was feeling itchy on my forehead and the sides of my face itched. I stopping using it because my face felt too dry. 4) ON FIRE -- my face was on fire - picture 1. It got so bad I wanted to cry. Went to the doctors because this was just getting worse. 5) Diagnosis - severe contact dermatitis. Steroids' and steroid cream for me now. 6) Still feel like my face is on fire. Picture 2 is after 4 days of 4 pills a day and cream -- still not happy. So pic #2 is today -- still pretty inflamed but getting better. I don't like trashing something that works well for so many - hence the 2 stars - but please be aware this can happen to you. If your skin is sensitive, I'd take a pass.

avis.titre: WILL PURGE PORES - Works great, but be aware that it will make you break out first.

It will cause you to get itchy bumps, small whiteheads, some breakouts if you use it every single day, 2. If you use retinol do not mix them. Use the glycolic acid in the morning and retinol at night. I added pictures from when my skin purged, and it wasn’t pleasant. However, after two to three weeks my skin is smoother than it’s ever been, I don’t break out and my pores are much much smaller. I had luck with applying moisturizer before and after the glycolic acid pads and that helped with irritation. I hope this is helpful, I really love this product!

Last year my skin broke out for the first time in my life ( I am in my late 20s). I tried different face washes, topicals, antibiotics, anti-fungal’s. Nothing worked. I saw these face wipes on Amazon and decided to give them a try. The first photo was taken in January (before the face wipes) and the second photo was taken in April (3 months after I started using the face wipes). However, I believe my skin had completely cleared up by late February. I read reviews that mentioned these face wipes can cause your acne to purge and temporarily get worse before it gets better. This happened to me, but I promise the results will absolutely be worth the temporary flare up. These wipes do tend to dry out your skin, so I recommend using Aquaphor at least 3 to 4 times a week while using them daily. I still use these wipes 3 to 4 times per week and it has prevented the acne from returning. I do not typically write reviews and I have never posted photos to Amazon for reviews. But I am hoping my skin journey helps others make the decision to buy these wipes. I only wish I had found them sooner!
